jobs.excerpt: 📍 Location: Remote (Germany / Austria/ Other European Countries) ⏱️ Type of Employment: Full-time Talent Development & Learning Specialist Harris means choice, expertise & relationship.
jobs.description:
📍 Location: Remote (Germany / Austria/ Other European Countries)
⏱️ Type of Employment: Full-time

Talent Development & Learning Specialist

Harris means choice, expertise & relationship. Choice among industry leading software solutions. Expertise from our employees who are industry, regulatory and domain experts. Relationships for the long term. We want our customers to be customers for life, and we focus on creating customer experience that will deliver on this goal. We combine choice, expertise & relationship with profitable growth and an environment of openness, trust and credibility. At Harris, we do the right thing when it comes to our customers and our employees.

We invite you to join us and be a part of our exciting journey! We are looking for a Talent Development & Learning Specialistto join our HR International team. This will be remote work.

We are looking for a passionate and creative Talent Development & Learning specialist to join our team. The role will focus on designing and delivering impactful behavioral learning experiences that help employees and leaders build critical capabilities and perform at their best.

The ideal candidate understands adult learning principles, can translate business needs into engaging learning solutions, and is comfortable creating training content using both traditional as well as modern methodologies.

What will be your impact?

Learning Needs Analysis

  • Partner with business leaders, HR Business Partners, and managers to identify capability requirements and skill gaps

  • Conduct Training Needs Analysis (TNA) using business inputs, employee feedback, performance data, and organizational priorities

  • Translate identified needs into relevant learning interventions and development plans

Behavioral Training Design & Content Development

  • Design and develop behavioral and soft-skills programs from concept to delivery

  • Create training content, participant materials, activities, case studies, assessments, and learning modules

  • Develop programs covering areas such as communication, influencing, leadership, collaboration, stakeholder management, executive presence, coaching and feedback, conflict management, change management, decision-making, and professional effectiveness

  • Apply adult learning, instructional design, and experiential learning principles

Training Delivery & Facilitation

  • Design and facilitate instructor-led, virtual, in-person, and blended learning programs

  • Deliver onboarding and employee development programs

  • Use engaging methodologies such as discussions, role plays, simulations, and case studies

  • Continuously improve programs based on learner feedback and outcomes

Learning Programs & E-Learning

  • Support the design and implementation of onboarding, e-learning, leadership development, and other talent development programs

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external partners to develop scalable learning solutions

  • Leverage digital learning platforms and emerging technologies to enhance the learning experience

Learning Effectiveness & ROI

  • Define measures to evaluate learning effectiveness and business impact

  • Track participation, completion, learner feedback, skill improvement, and application of learning

  • Analyze learning data and report on program effectiveness and ROI

  • Use insights to continuously improve learning solutions

Workday Learning

  • Working knowledge of Workday Learning, with the ability to independently manage learning programs, courses, learner assignments, training records, reporting, and day-to-day L&D administration

What are we looking for?

  • AI & Innovation Mindset - We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and deliver stronger business outcomes.The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt AI-enabled tools to improve workflows, solve problems, support decision-making, and increase efficiency. They should be comfortable incorporating these technologies into their day-to-day work while applying appropriate professional judgment and adhering to relevant security, confidentiality, and compliance requirements

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in human resources, Organizational Psychology, Education, Business Administration, or a related field

  • 2–4 years of relevant experience in Learning & Development, Talent Development, Training, or Organizational Development

  • Demonstrated experience designing and delivering behavioral/soft-skills training

  • Experience independently creating learning content and training materials

  • Experience in a multinational/corporate environment is an advantage

  • Location: Remote – Germany / Austria/ Other European Countries

  • Travel: ~30% within and outside base location

  • Willing to work flexible hours to provide support to other geographies

  • Languages: German & English – Expert level; French working knowledge is an advantage

  • Employment Type: Full-time

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong facilitation, presentation, and communication skills

  • Strong instructional design and content development capabilities

  • Ability to create behavioral training programs from scratch

  • Good understanding of adult learning principles and methodologies

  • Strong stakeholder management and consulting skills

  • Ability to conduct TNA and translate business needs into learning solutions

  • Data-driven approach to measuring learning effectiveness

  • Ability to work effectively with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams

  • Creative, curious, and passionate about employee development

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, multicultural, multinational environment

  • Willing to travel for work in and outside Germany

What Success Looks Like

Understand the business → Identify capability gaps → Design the right learning solution → Create compelling content → Facilitate impactful experiences → Measure learning and business impact.

jobs.description:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

Your Next Destination

  • Location: Remote.
  • Contract: Full-time, permanent.
  • Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link -
  • Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.
As a Training Specialist on the Support Operations team, you design, develop, and deliver training that keeps our internal support teams and vendor partners informed, skilled, and ready for production. Your work sits at the intersection of Support operations and learning design: you translate SOP changes, QA findings, workflow updates, and product launches into practical training that agents and vendor trainers can apply immediately.

This is a hands-on training role: you are expected to be comfortable facilitating, coaching, observing delivery, and working directly with agents and vendor trainers—not only creating materials. You are responsible for the quality of the training you develop and deliver, and for keeping your manager informed so they can make decisions, remove blockers, and connect your work to broader business priorities.

What you'll do

  • Design and develop training programs, refreshers, onboarding modules, job aids, and assessments for internal support teams and vendor partners.
  • Convert complex workflows, SOPs, and product changes into clear, practical, learner-friendly materials.
  • Keep assigned training materials accurate and up to date as processes, tools, and policies change.
  • Maintain version control and change logs for materials you own.
  • Facilitate training sessions, onboarding programs, and practice-based learning activities for internal and vendor audiences, providing direct coaching and actionable feedback to agents and vendor trainers.
  • Use practical methods such as ticket simulations, scenario exercises, observations, and knowledge checks to build confidence and support application in production—not just comprehension.
  • Capture recurring learner confusion and escalate patterns to your manager rather than resolving systemic issues independently.
  • Participate in Train-the-Trainer (TTT) sessions to help prepare vendor trainers to deliver Airalo training accurately.
  • Support new vendor onboarding by contributing training materials and delivery support.
  • Observe vendor-led refresher training and document feedback on delivery quality against agreed standards.
  • Share observations and follow-up needs with your manager; decisions on remediation or certification sit with the Training Manager.
  • Use QA findings, CSAT signals, ticket trends, and stakeholder input to identify training gaps for the areas you are assigned.
  • Confirm with your manager whether the identified need calls for training, a job aid, an SOP update, or a different intervention.
  • Review training results and post-training performance signals—including learner feedback, QA findings, assessment trends, production performance, and direct observations—to identify where learners are struggling and whether the training is being applied effectively.
  • Bring clear findings and practical recommendations to your manager; final decisions on broader interventions, remediation, or process changes remain with the manager.
  • Coordinate logistics, timelines, attendance, and materials with the teams involved in your assigned programs.
  • Share clear updates on progress, readiness, and blockers with relevant stakeholders.
  • Escalate conflicting inputs, unclear priorities, or decisions with broader business impact to your manager before acting.
  • Use tools such as Genially, Google AI Studio, and Google Apps Script to improve the quality and efficiency of training materials where appropriate.
  • Apply technology within the standards and guardrails your manager has set; flag new tool ideas for review before adopting them.

What you'll bring:

  • Proven ability to learn new processes quickly, absorb operational context, and translate it into training others can apply immediately.
  • Proven hands-on experience in a training or learning design role, preferably in a customer support environment. This is not an entry-level transition into training; you should already be able to facilitate, coach, observe, and give actionable feedback with confidence.
  • Strong understanding of instructional design principles and adult learning theory.
  • Excellent facilitation, coaching, observation, and presentation skills, including remote delivery.
  • Ability to create clear, practical training materials that people can apply in production.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to adapt to different audiences.
  • Comfortable working within defined scope and escalating decisions rather than acting independently on things that affect broader operations.
  • Organised, reliable, and consistent in follow-through.
  • Advanced English.

Nice To Haves:

  • Prior experience in a telecommunications or eSIM-related environment.
  • Knowledge of GSMA-related technologies and services.
  • Familiarity with Zendesk or similar support tools.
  • Experience with learning tools such as Genially, Google AI Studio, or similar.
  • Availability to work in shifts.

At Airalo, we believe in roaming-free recruitment. Just as we provide clear connectivity for travelers, we provide clear salary ranges for our candidates. 🌍

This role is remote and open to candidates across our supported locations in Europe. The range below reflects the full salary range for this role across the countries where it's available:

📍 Philippines: ₱1,092,400 – ₱1,638,600

Your Home Destination: 🛫 Local market rates and cost of living vary. Your specific range within this band depends on where you're based, and there's room to discuss what's right for the person and the role. We'll walk through your range together on your first call with our Talent team so we're aligned for takeoff! 🎒✨

Why People Join Us

We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.

Our team spans 60+ countries, united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one.

As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact - from anywhere in the world.

Before You Hit Apply

By applying, you acknowledge and agree that, in case of successful application, Airalo may request to run background checks as a condition for entering into an agreement with you. Rest assured that these checks will only occur upon your prior consent and at the end of the selection process, and will be strictly limited to what is allowed under the laws that are applicable to you. All data that you share or that we collect in connection with such checks will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy, available here:
We sincerely thank all applicants in advance for submitting their interest in this opportunity. Airalo is an equal-opportunity employer and values diversity, equity & inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations upon request for individuals with disabilities throughout our job interview process.

jobs.title: OD & Learning Solutions Associate
jobs.excerpt: The OD & Learning Solutions Associate is a full-time, remote role responsible for designing, implementing, and managing organizational development and learning interventions for client organizations.
jobs.description:
The OD & Learning Solutions Associate is a full-time, remote role responsible for designing, implementing, and managing organizational development and learning interventions for client organizations. This role includes conducting needs assessments, supporting competency mapping, and translating business and talent gaps into structured learning and OD solutions. The associate will design and refine training programs and blended learning journeys, while coordinating with facilitators and client stakeholders to ensure effective delivery. Daily responsibilities involve working with learning management systems, creating or improving learning content, tracking program effectiveness through data and feedback, and preparing reports and recommendations for clients. The role also collaborates with internal teams to continuously improve frameworks, tools, and processes that support talent development and organizational effectiveness.

Qualifications

  • Candidates should possess skills in Learning Management and Learning Management Systems to design, administer, and track development programs effectively.

  • Candidates should possess skills in Training & Development to plan, deliver, and evaluate blended learning and capability-building interventions.

  • Candidates should possess skills in Instructional Design to create structured, engaging, and outcome-focused learning content and experiences.

  • Candidates should possess strong Communication skills to collaborate with stakeholders, facilitate discussions, and present insights and recommendations clearly.

  • 5+ years of experience in organizational development, learning solutions, HR consulting, or related fields.

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Psychology, Learning & Development, or a related discipline.

  • Experience with assessments, competency frameworks, and data-driven evaluation of learning outcomes.

  • Ability to work independently in a remote setting, manage multiple projects, and meet client timelines.

  • Familiarity with e-learning authoring tools, gamified learning approaches, and blended learning models is beneficial.

jobs.description:
OUR HIRING PROCESS:

  • We will review your application against our job requirements. We do not employ machine learning technologies during this phase as we believe every human deserves attention from another human. We do not think machines can evaluate your application quite like our seasoned recruiting professionals—every person is unique. We promise to give your candidacy a fair and detailed assessment.
  • We may then invite you to submit a video interview for the review of the hiring manager. This video interview is often followed by a test or short project that allows us to determine whether you will be a good fit for the team.
  • At this point, we will invite you to interview with our hiring manager and/or the interview team. Please note: We do not conduct interviews via text message, Telegram, etc. and we never hire anyone into our organization without having met you face-to-face (or via Zoom). You will be invited to come to a live meeting or Zoom, where you will meet our INFUSE team.
  • From there on, it’s decision time! If you are still excited to join INFUSE and we like you as much, we will have a conversation about your offer. We do not make offers without giving you the opportunity to speak with us live.

    INFUSE is committed to complying with applicable data privacy and security laws and regulations. For more information, please see our Privacy Policy

INFUSE is a demand generation company providing solutions to B2B organizations. We help clients and partners to deliver audience, buyers, and account engagement that meets their goals. With a global team operating across more than 60 countries, the company has been recognized multiple times on the prestigious Inc. 5000 list, and has received over 60 other industry awards, including Inc. Best Workplaces.

We are seeking a creative and strategic Instructional Designer to craft impactful learning experiences that combine the best of digital and human interaction. In this role, you will partner with subject matter experts and stakeholders to design modern, engaging programs for adult professionals—leveraging both evidence-based instructional design principles and the latest in generative AI technologies.

INFUSE Academy drives both internal and external online education, creating smart, high-impact e-learning experiences that fuel real business results.

We’re not just checking boxes – we’re designing innovative, engaging, and practical e-learning programs that empower people to grow and thrive.

As we scale, we’re looking for a strategic and growth-oriented Instructional Designer to join our fast-paced, tight-knit team of passionate professionals. If you’re someone who brings bold ideas, loves experimenting with new approaches, and thrives in a collaborative environment, this is your moment.

Our L&D philosophy

We’re committed to delivering practical, growth-driven education that aligns with both business objectives and learner needs. Most of our solutions are designed as self-paced, asynchronous e-learning experiences, enhanced with AI-powered tools and immersive learning simulators.

We believe learning should be engaging and story-driven. Inspired by platforms like Netflix, we continuously experiment with storytelling techniques to make development experiences more compelling and impactful.

We're looking for someone who:

  • Has a background in instructional design and AI implementation
  • Understands the capabilities and limitations of LLMs (like GPT-4)
  • Can prototype and configure custom GPTs and similar AI tools for learning solutions
  • Is detail-oriented, innovative, and comfortable in a fast-paced, iterative environment
  • Loves solving problems creatively and making learning experiences smarter and more engaging

Key responsibilities

  • Collaborate with internal subject matter experts (SMEs) and key stakeholders to design and deliver effective blended learning programs that align with business goals
  • Apply principles of andragogy and evidence-based instructional design to create engaging, learner-centric experiences for adult professionals
  • Design and curate blended learning solutions using a mix of learning formats (e.g., eLearning, self-paced modules, virtual training sessions, and on-the-job activities)
  • Ensure instructional consistency, accessibility, and relevance of content across delivery modes
  • Leverage generative AI tools, including designing and deploying custom GPTs, to support learning
  • Manage project timelines, resources, and communication workflows to ensure the timely and organized execution of learning initiatives

What we offer

  • A dynamic and supportive team environment focused on innovation in learning.
  • Meaningful involvement in training initiatives with global impact.
  • Career growth potential within a fast-paced, purpose-driven team.
  • Access to cutting-edge e-learning tools and approaches.
  • Access to high-quality professional development resources and marketing insights.

If you recognize yourself in this and are up to the challenge, we’d be happy to hear from you!

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We make hiring decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diversity of experience, culture, and perspective makes us stronger.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator, AI Initiative
jobs.excerpt: The Pulitzer Center champions the power of stories to make complex issues relevant and inspire action.
jobs.description:
The Pulitzer Center champions the power of stories to make complex issues relevant and inspire action. We have a bold vision: to be the venue for the world’s most innovative and consequential reporting, with journalism as the key element for mobilizing society through audience engagement strategies. Founded in 2006, the Center is an essential source of support for enterprise reporting in the United States and across the globe. The thousands of journalists and educators who are part of our networks span more than 80 countries. Our work reaches tens of millions of people each year through our news-media partners and an audience-centered strategy of global and regional engagement. We believe that people and communities who actively engage with systemic challenges will find solutions together. By supporting journalists as they conduct in-depth investigations, produce compelling stories, and engage diverse audiences, we create a ripple effect of world-changing impact.

About the role

The Pulitzer Center seeks an organized, mission-driven coordinator to support the growing work of our AI Initiative. As Program Coordinator, AI Initiative, you’ll be at the operational center of one of our most dynamic editorial programs—managing communications, coordinating training programs, supporting grantees and fellows, and helping ensure that our AI-focused journalism and education work runs with precision and purpose.

The AI Program Coordinator is a crucial part of the AI Accountability Network with responsibilities for coordinating activities from the AI Spotlight Series, biweekly AI newsletter, grants and fellowships. As the Network is in a period of growth, the Coordinator will work closely with our AI Spotlight Series coordinator, AI editors, and operations team to ensure programs are run effectively and can scale. The Coordinator will work with both internal and external partners across the globe. This is primarily an administrative role requiring good communication, organization and an attention to detail, but we value experimentation and creativity across the team.

Responsibilities

AI Newsletter

  • Source content for the newsletter by identifying relevant stories and authors from recently published work and soliciting written content
  • Coordinate the production of the bi-weekly AI newsletter, ensuring a smooth editorial workflow by tasks including but not limited to scheduling writers for the topper, setting targets, and tracking metrics.

AI Spotlight Series Coordination Support

  • Implement the AI Spotlight Series in collaboration with external contractors to ensure coordination in alignment with Pulitzer process, including overseeing scheduling and event coordination (identifying coaches, sourcing live translators, arranging regional partnerships for promotion, providing technical support, and developing and assessing trainee surveys).
  • Support the AI Spotlight Series consultants with growing our community building initiatives, including promotion and technical support
  • Identify in-person opportunities for coaches to deliver the AI Spotlight Series modules and coordinate the event planning.
  • Manage the application process for training sessions, including reviewing applications and selecting candidates
  • Liaise between the external contractors, including coaches, videographers and others in producing the AI Spotlight Series online curriculum
  • Provide support for ongoing development of the AI Spotlight Series curriculum
  • Coordinate content and design updates to our AI Spotlight Series website
  • Build and maintain dashboards across platforms for metrics including website traffic, etc, to improve and ensure data access for analysis and strategic considerations of usability, accessibility, and reach
  • Liaise with the external web developers and others in support of data analysis as needed
  • Manage the AI Listserv by moderating, writing content, and admin configuration of the platform to support the growth of the AI Listserv and facilitate community

Editorial Program (AI) Coordination

  • Process paperwork for approved reporting projects, schedule grantee payments and AI Spotlight Series payments accordingly, book travel insurance, track deliverables, and finalize the project statuses.
  • Support the AI and administrative team members in obtaining and processing grant paperwork from coaches, fellows, and grantees, tracking status against schedules, troubleshooting issues and escalating to relevant teams as needed for all AI programs, including but not limited to the AI Spotlight Series
  • Administer the process of issuing programmatic payments to external partners, fellows, grantees and others by scheduling payments in alignment with legal agreements, setting expectations with payees regarding timelines and documentation requirements, and escalating issues across departments as needed
  • Track impact across our activities and create metrics to help with decision making.
  • Liaise with the Communications team on behalf of the AI Editorial team, to ensure promotion of events, programs, and new resources are effectively communicated to the right audiences and work collaboratively across the two teams
  • Support AI team members with funder communications and reports by providing data, reports, and drafting content
  • Support the participation of AI team members and grantees in affinity conferences, including organizing panels, logistics and travel
  • Support the development of AI products and programming, including the launch of new or special initiatives.

General Editorial team support

  • Manage and reply to questions from the editorial email
  • Support admin team members in Editorial admin tasks such as collecting and analyzing grantee demographic data via quarterly surveys.
  • Support website content development by the Communications team and internal website publishing as needed.
  • Provide copywriting support for email and website as needed.

Participation in Pulitzer Center culture and values

  • This may include task forces, training sessions, meetings, committees, special projects, organizational events, and any other activities that support the Pulitzer Center.
  • Participate in the planning processes for the organization.

Qualifications

  • 5 years of experience supporting administrative and programmatic activities for distributed teams
  • A demonstrated interest in or knowledge of issues connected to tech impact on society, algorithmic accountability, and related issues
  • Experience in or demonstrated interest and understanding of AI in journalism and media
  • The ability to work independently and take initiative
  • Strong organizational and communication skills, handling several projects simultaneously and on time
  • The ability to develop and maintain agile and efficient workflows and systems that support a complex program
  • Cultural awareness and sensitivity to work across nationalities with colleagues and grantees
  • Proficiency speaking one or more of the Pulitzer Center languages plus English (Spanish, Portuguese, Bahasa Indonesia, French).
  • Background in grant administration or payment processing in a nonprofit context
  • The ability to center equity and collaboration in all aspects of the work
  • Familiarity with training coordination, including virtual event logistics and survey analysis
  • Experience building newsletters with community management (listservs, online communities, or similar)
  • Experience working with spreadsheets and tabular data
  • Knowledge of website analytics tools and accessibility best practices

Success Metrics

Your impact will be measured by:

  • Newsletter Quality & Consistency: Reliable, on-schedule production of the bi-weekly AI newsletter with strong editorial workflow management
  • Training Coordination: Smooth execution of AI Spotlight Series sessions, including logistics, coach scheduling, and participant experience
  • Grants & Payments Accuracy: Timely and error-free processing of grant paperwork, payments, and project documentation
  • Impact Tracking: Development and maintenance of metrics that support program learning and decision-making
  • Stakeholder Communication: Responsiveness and clarity in managing communications with grantees, coaches, trainees, and internal teams
  • Process Improvement: Identification and implementation of workflow enhancements that improve program efficiency
  • Community Growth: Expansion and engagement of the AI Listserv and related community-building initiatives

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary Range: $54,500 - $62,000 annually, commensurate with experience
  • Comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, retirement plan with employer contribution, generous PTO, and professional development support
  • Remote work arrangement with flexibility for work-life balance. This position is fully remote and open to candidates located anywhere in the World.
  • The ideal candidate will be comfortable with regular virtual collaboration, occasional multi-day travel commitments, and flexible scheduling to accommodate partners across time zones.

Compensation for US-based employees: Salary range listed above is for US-based employees. Our benefit package includes paid time off (holiday, vacation, parental, and sick), health care coverage (including medical/dental/vision), health savings accounts, 403(b) retirement plan, transit benefit, parental leave, and Life & ADD/LTD/STD Insurance.

Equal Opportunity Employer

The Pulitzer Center is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We strongly encourage applications from people of color, women, LGBTQ+ individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign-born residents, and veterans. We value diverse perspectives and life experiences.

Questions?

To learn more about our work, visit pulitzercenter.org.

The Pulitzer Center on Crisis Reporting is committed to supporting in-depth international journalism and using storytelling to drive public discourse and civic engagement on critical global issues. Join us in shaping how the world engages with the stories that matter most.
